text:
leila: Heads-up: node SDK (v1.4.0) is shipping camelCase query params for the batch embeddings endpoint. REST expects snake_case. Quickstart sample returns wrong results during onboarding.
omar: Oof. Which param?
leila: `include_total` -> SDK sends `includeTotal=true`. Server ignores it, so pagination/summary info is missing and the sampleapp thinks results are empty.
leila: Minimal reproducer:
```
# curl (REST canonical)
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch?include_total=true' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-batch","inputs":["a","b"]}'
# returns: {"results":[...], "total":2}
```
```
// node SDK naive
const resp = await client.embeddings.batch({model: 'embed-batch', inputs: ['a','b'], includeTotal: true})
// resp.body -> {results:[...]}  // no total
```
omar: That's rough. SDK should preserve the REST param names exactly (or map explicitly). This is a compatibility bug, not a feature.
sdk-bot: New issue created: redwood/sdk#679 - "Node SDK: query param casing causes missing pagination metadata"
leila: Also noticed retry behavior mismatch: when service returns 503 + `Retry-After: 10`, the SDK retries immediately 3 times (exponential jitter disabled) instead of honoring header. Our client library uses a generic axios retry wrapper that didn't check `retry-after`.
omar: Combine these and new users see missing totals + fast retries leading to 500s on onboarding scripts. Bad first impression.
eng-runtime: ping - did we ever change query param canonicalization? Server middleware accepts both cases for internal APIs but public endpoint is strict. We'll add server-side leniency, but SDK still needs to match.
leila: Workarounds: sampleapp now normalizes both shapes: check `resp.total || resp.body.total || resp.body.total_count` but it's messy. I've pushed a small helper util in sample-apps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/104 (draft).
omar: For retries, suggest honoring `Retry-After` first, then exponential backoff. Also add a feature flag in SDK so we can opt-in to legacy behavior while rolling out.
sdk-bot: Assigned to @sdk-maintainers and @eng-runtime. ETA request added.
devex: Can SDK teams cut a patch? This is blocking quickstart labs for new hires today.
sdk-bot: Maintainers responded: patch requested. Target 1.4.1 (hotfix) within 24h, full 1.5.0 with mapping tests and CI baseline in two weeks.
leila: I'll add an integration test to devex CI that starts from the quickstart script and validates sample outputs match REST responses. Filed INF-2281 to track.
eng-runtime: We'll relax server to accept camelCase for backward compatibility, but SDK must still ship fix to be correct long-term.
omar: Also please add a changelog entry and note in migration docs: "Node SDK 1.4.1 fixes query param casing and honors Retry-After headers".
leila: Thanks. If anyone sees other parity drift (headers, shapes, param names), drop them here and I'll collect into a spike to audit all core endpoints.
